description: This file defines the TlsClientConnectionMiddleware class, which manages TLS handshake and secure connection setup for client connections in a server framework. It handles SSL stream initialization, certificate validation, and feature setting within connection contexts.

classes.name: TlsClientConnectionMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware responsible for establishing TLS connections, performing handshakes, and setting relevant connection features for client connections.

methods.name: TlsClientConnectionMiddleware
methods.description: Constructor initializing the middleware with connection delegate, TLS options, and logger factory.

methods.name: OnConnectionAsync
methods.description: Entry point for processing an incoming connection asynchronously.

methods.name: InnerOnConnectionAsync
methods.description: Performs TLS handshake, certificate validation, and sets up secure transport within the connection context.

methods.name: ValidateCertificate
methods.description: Validates the provided client certificate based on configured certificate mode.

methods.name: EnsureCertificateIsAllowedForClientAuth
methods.description: Checks whether the given certificate is valid for client authentication.

methods.name: ConvertToX509Certificate2
methods.description: Converts an X509Certificate to X509Certificate2 if necessary.
